description: Source code for account move line management in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including classes for account move lines and bank statement reconciliation, with methods for querying, creating, updating, reconciling, and view rendering.

classes.name: account_move_line
classes.description: Model class for account move lines, handling querying, creation, update, reconciliation, and view rendering.

classes.name: account_bank_statement_reconcile
classes.description: Extension of account.bank.statement.reconcile with additional line_ids field.

methods.name: _query_get
methods.description: Constructs SQL query conditions for fetching move lines based on context filters.

methods.name: default_get
methods.description: Provides default values for new move line records, considering manual entry context.

methods.name: create_analytic_lines
methods.description: Creates analytic lines associated with the move line if an analytic account is set.

methods.name: _default_get_move_form_hook
methods.description: Removes analytic_account_id and account_tax_id keys from data during manual move entry.

methods.name: _default_get
methods.description: Computes default values for move lines, including manual entry and move context.

methods.name: _get_date
methods.description: Determines default date for move line based on journal and period.

methods.name: _get_currency
methods.description: Returns the currency ID associated with the journal.

methods.name: onchange_currency
methods.description: Updates debit and credit fields based on selected currency and account.

methods.name: onchange_partner_id
methods.description: Updates partner-related fields and account based on partner selection.

methods.name: onchange_account_id
methods.description: Sets tax_id based on selected account and partner.

methods.name: reconcile_partial
methods.description: Performs partial reconciliation of move lines.

methods.name: reconcile
methods.description: Performs full reconciliation of move lines, including write-offs and move creation.

methods.name: view_header_get
methods.description: Generates header string for move line views based on context.

methods.name: fields_view_get
methods.description: Generates XML view architecture for move lines, especially tree views with dynamic domain and styling.

methods.name: _check_moves
methods.description: Checks if the first move for a journal and period is still in draft state.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes move lines and validates associated moves if necessary.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Updates move lines, with checks for account activity, move state, and reconciliation status.

methods.name: _update_journal_check
methods.description: Ensures journal and period are open for modifications, creating journal period if needed.

methods.name: _update_check
methods.description: Checks move lines for move and reconciliation constraints before update.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new move line, handling move creation, account validation, taxes, and analytic lines.
